title: Harness of Minervini v2 watchlist.record response

examples: scripts/.venv/bin/python scripts/pipeline watchlist record AAPL --instrument-id nasdaq-trader:NASDAQ:AAPL --output-hash 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef --verdict WAIT --condition 'completed close above pivot' --invalidation 'completed close below base low'

exit_codes.0: A valid domain envelope was emitted; its status may still be partial, unavailable, or needs_input.
exit_codes.2: The request or arguments were invalid; stdout contains a needs_input error envelope.
exit_codes.3: An unexpected internal contract failure occurred; stdout contains an unavailable error envelope.

as_of.description: Completed US trading session in YYYY-MM-DD form; defaults to the latest completed regular session.

condition.description: Condition that would authorize or change action.

doctrine_ids.description: Repeatable doctrine claim IDs used by the decision.

format.description: Output detail only; compact preserves verdict, signals, and missing evidence while omitting verbose basis rows.

instrument_id.description: Stable instrument ID from the security master.

invalidation.description: Condition that invalidates the thesis or setup.

output_hash.description: 64-character SHA-256 of the analysis output being recorded.

limitations: This command does not infer or recompute a verdict; it records exactly what the caller supplies.
No position size, allocation, quantity, or account data is accepted.
x-capability-contract.output: The inserted research record and its stable ledger fields.
side_effects: Creates or updates the ignored SQLite ledger at .state/research-ledger.sqlite3, or MINERVINI_LEDGER_PATH.

status_meanings.needs_input: A required field or SHA-256 digest is invalid.

x-capability-contract.summary: Explicitly persist an auditable research verdict after analysis.
